title: "Are We Living in the Last Days? Signs of Jesus’ Return" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Are We Living in the Last Days? Signs of Jesus’ Return" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Look around. The world is falling apart.

Wars and conflicts are increasing.
Natural disasters are striking harder than ever.
Morality is collapsing.
Hatred, lawlessness, and deception are everywhere.
🚨 Is this just another bad time in history? Or are we witnessing the signs of the Last Days?

📖 “You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come. Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places. All these are the beginning of birth pains.” (Matthew 24:6-8)
💡 The Bible warned us thousands of years ago—and it’s happening NOW.

🔥 1. Jesus Gave Us Signs to Watch For
Many people ignore the warnings or say, “People have been saying this for years.”
But Jesus told us to stay alert and recognize the signs.
📖 “When you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.” (Matthew 24:33)
💡 We are seeing ALL the signs happening together—at a level never seen before.

🔥 2. What Are the Signs of the Last Days?
1️⃣ Increase in Wars and Conflicts
We are seeing wars, civil unrest, and violent conflicts worldwide.
Rumors of war spread daily between nations.
📖 “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.” (Matthew 24:7)
🚨 Global tensions are higher than ever!

2️⃣ Lawlessness and Moral Collapse
Crime, corruption, and wickedness are rising.
Sexual immorality, perversion, and broken families are becoming normal.
Evil is celebrated, and righteousness is mocked.
📖 “People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy, without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good.” (2 Timothy 3:1-3)
🚨 The world has completely abandoned biblical morals.

3️⃣ False Prophets and Deception Everywhere
Fake pastors and false religions are misleading millions.
False signs, miracles, and demonic deceptions are fooling people.
People love false teachers who tell them what they want to hear.
📖 “For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.” (Matthew 24:24)
🚨 The world is following lies instead of truth!

4️⃣ Increase in Natural Disasters and Climate Chaos
Earthquakes, hurricanes, wildfires, floods, and extreme weather are worse than ever before.
The world calls it “climate change,” but Jesus told us this would happen.
📖 “There will be famines and earthquakes in various places. All these are the beginning of birth pains.” (Matthew 24:7-8)
🚨 These disasters are not just random—they are warnings!

5️⃣ Rise of a One-World System
The world is preparing for global control—economically, politically, and religiously.
Governments push for digital ID, cashless economies, and mass surveillance.
The idea of a global leader (Antichrist) is becoming more accepted.
📖 “It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads, so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark.” (Revelation 13:16-17)
🚨 A global system of control is forming—just as the Bible predicted!

🔥 3. What Should We Do?
1️⃣ Don’t Ignore the Signs – Be Ready!
Jesus is coming soon—this is not the time to be asleep spiritually.
Many will mock these warnings, but that’s another sign of the Last Days.
📖 “You must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect Him.” (Matthew 24:44)
💡 The biggest danger is thinking you have more time.

2️⃣ Repent and Surrender to Jesus NOW
Many people are still playing with sin—but tomorrow is not promised.
Jesus could return any moment, or your life could end at any time.
📖 “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.” (Matthew 4:17)
🚨 Make sure you are saved and following Jesus with your whole heart!

3️⃣ Share the Gospel Urgently
People are dying without Jesus every day.
We have a short time to warn them and lead them to Christ.
📖 “Go into all the world and preach the Gospel to all creation.” (Mark 16:15)
🚨 The time to share Jesus is NOW—before it’s too late!

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 19, 2025 📜
"I believe we are living in the Last Days. I choose to stay awake, live for Jesus, and warn others before it’s too late. I will not ignore the signs—I will prepare my heart and proclaim the truth."

🔥 THE “LAST DAYS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly saved, or just religious?
✅ Step 3: Warn others about the signs of Jesus’ return!

🌌 DON’T WAIT – JESUS IS COMING SOON 🌌
📖 “Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy written in this scroll.” (Revelation 22:7)

👉 Will you be ready when Jesus returns?
👉 Or will you be one of those who ignored the warnings?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 19, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for giving us the signs of Your return. I don’t want to be caught sleeping spiritually. Wake me up! Help me to live in full obedience to You and boldly share the truth with others. Let me be found faithful when You return.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
